name: Slashing Rune
disable: DC 25 Thievery check (trained) to silently erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune

items.name: Slash
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts a Thievery check to Pick the Lock

---
Effect Knives of force deal 4d8+18 slashing damage to the triggering creature (DC 25 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, the creature also takes a –1 penalty to Dex-based skills for 1 hour.

text: An invisible rune creates knives of force if someone tries to bypass the lock.
